required_stages.description: Copy input into a run-allocated key buffer (timed), allocate a second key buffer and the per-pass histogram/scan scratch inside run().
Per digit pass: per-block exact counts of keys per digit value written to a histogram.
Per digit pass: exclusive prefix sum over the histogram yielding the global write base for each (digit value, block), completed before any scatter of that pass.
Per digit pass: each key written to base[digit, block] + its rank among same-digit keys preceding it in the block, into the other key buffer (stable partition).

Passes run least-significant digit first and together cover all 32 key bits, swapping the two key buffers after every pass; no data-dependent pass skipping; the buffer written by the final pass is returned.

forbidden_substitutions.message: A PyTorch sort replaces the whole computation.
A tensor-method sort on the host replaces the whole computation.
A DSL comparison-sort primitive or network replaces the radix passes; it may not produce the final order.
Host-side histogram or scan (torch.cumsum/bincount/histc or a tensor-method cumsum) replaces a per-pass stage; in-kernel scans are required and not flagged.
The input must never be written or returned.
Possible data-dependent or incomplete pass coverage; all 32 bits must be processed.
Possible state cached across calls; everything must be recomputed inside run().

required_evidence.message: No kernel-level prefix scan found; the per-pass scan and in-block rank must be computed in kernels.
No working copy of the input found; the input must not be sorted in place.
No evidence that the pass loop covers all 32 key bits.

outputs.aliasing: none with respect to input; the returned (N,) int32 tensor is one of the key buffers allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: Everything inside run() is timed: the working copy (clone) of input, all allocations (two key buffers plus histogram/scan scratch), every digit pass (count, scan, stable scatter) and the buffer swaps. No cached state across calls, no untimed presort or prepacking. bytes_expr in config.yaml assumes a fixed pass count and omits the clone; see audit review items.
